  "statement": "Let $\\operatorname{W}$ be the local-set-based wavelet basis with the even partition. For a fixed sparsity level $K$, consider signals $\\mathbf{x}$ satisfying\n\n$$\n\\left\\|\\Delta\\mathbf{x}\\right\\|_0\\leq K.\n$$\n\n**Optimality conjecture.** The local-set-based wavelet basis $\\operatorname{W}_{\\rm LSPC}$ minimizes, among all orthonormal bases $\\operatorname{F}$, the worst-case number of nonzero coefficients:\n\n$$\n\\operatorname{W}_{\\rm LSPC}=\\arg\\min_{\\operatorname{F}}\\ \\max_{\\mathbf{x}:\\,\\left\\|\\Delta\\mathbf{x}\\right\\|_0\\leq K}\\left\\|\\operatorname{F}^T\\mathbf{x}\\right\\|_0,\n$$\n\nsubject to $\\operatorname{F}$ being orthonormal. The conjecture asserts that this construction is optimal for promoting sparsity in piecewise-constant graph signals; the surrounding discussion establishes sparsity bounds for the proposed basis but provides no resolution of this global optimality claim.",
